summary: UMC filed a 6-K announcing pricing of its 7th unsecured overseas convertible bonds, per FSC letter dated October 2, 2026. Total issue is US$1.8 billion split evenly into Tranche A and B, at 100% of par, 0% coupon, no collateral, issue date October 13, 2026. Tranche A matures October 13, 2031 with -0.25% yield; Tranche B matures April 13, 2028 with -1.35% yield. Conversion into newly issued common shares begins three months after issue. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. Watch conversion-driven share overhang and the negative-yield structure's reception.
